note: Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest campground strung along the east shore of 129-acre Black Lake, about 30 minutes east of Hayward, in birch, pine and spruce woods; paved campground road. The 4-mile Black Lake Trail circles the lake. OHVs are not ridden in the campground; the Fishtrap motorized trail starts at the Camp Loretta trailhead 12 miles away. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + RIDB catalog + FS page read. $15 (groups $30), May 1 - Oct 15, 29 sites (25 take RVs, back-in, to 45 ft), reservations only in the summer peak, 4-day cutoff, 14-night max; hand pump, vault toilets, no dump. Phone: FS now lists the Hayward Office 715-638-7243.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (down, lakefront -> lakeview; not an --AWH value): the RV pads sit under continuous birch/pine canopy 30-60 m from the shore (site 8 at 45.98599,-90.93244 ~40 m; site 19 at 45.98844,-90.93037 ~40 m; site 24 at 45.98955,-90.93007 ~60 m; site 25 at 45.98927,-90.93002 ~55 m). The rec.gov photos of 4, 6, 8, 10, 14 and 16 show the lake through tree trunks; 1, 2, 20, 22, 24 and 25 show no water. Site 19's photo shows grass then a shrub fringe to the water, the nearest thing to open ground, but imagery shows a tree band there too. The one open strip to the shore is a grassy clearing at ~45.9870,-90.9317 beside group site 15 (the FS 'grassy beach'), which is day use.
